Name: SEO Foundations, Search Console & GA4 experiment
Action: Fix missing tracking first; do not optimise pages until the baseline and conversion events are reliable.

Name: Keyword Research & Search Intent experiment
Action: Prioritise one high-impression query with position 4–20, confirm its intent, and assign one best target page.

Name: On-Page SEO & Internal Linking experiment
Action: If impressions are stable but CTR falls, improve the title/description; if position falls, review intent, content and internal links.

Name: Technical SEO for a Recruitment Website experiment
Action: Resolve the highest-severity crawl, canonical or JobPosting issue, validate it, and annotate the fix date before judging KPI impact.

Name: Sector Landing Pages experiment
Action: Improve the sector page with the strongest combination of search demand and live jobs; review impressions first, then applications after 30 days.

Name: Topic Clusters & Topical Authority experiment
Action: Add contextual links to one under-supported pillar or sector page, then check discovery and landing-page traffic after 30 days.

Name: Employer SEO & Commercial Content experiment
Action: If employer traffic rises without leads, improve proof and the enquiry CTA; if visibility is weak, strengthen employer-intent content first.

Name: Content Quality, Refreshing & SEO Decisions experiment
Action: Select one page at position 4–20 or with high impressions and low CTR; make one focused change and set a 30-day review.

Name: Local SEO for Malta experiment
Action: Correct the most important NAP/profile inconsistency, record evidence, and compare branded clicks and leads monthly.

Name: Location Content & Citations experiment
Action: Build or improve only the location with both real vacancies and search demand; avoid thin pages where either signal is absent.

Name: Backlinks & Outreach experiment
Action: Focus outreach on one genuinely useful resource and high-relevance prospect; verify acquired links and review the target page monthly.

Name: Digital PR & Linkable Assets experiment
Action: Refine the asset or pitch using actual response and coverage data; never claim an outcome that the source data does not support.

Name: AEO – Answer Engine Optimization experiment
Action: Improve one answer block where impressions exist but CTR is weak; keep visible content and structured data consistent.

Name: GEO – Generative Engine Optimization experiment
Action: Strengthen one weak factual page with consistent organisation details, original evidence and cited sources, then record a dated observation.

Name: AI Search Visibility Tracking experiment
Action: Repeat the fixed prompt set before acting; improve the most relevant source page only when several observations show the same gap.

Name: Final Analysis & 90-Day Growth Plan experiment
Action: Compare equivalent periods, link each claimed win to evidence, and choose the next 90-day priorities by impact, confidence and effort.
